comment: I am writing in my role as Board President of the Wasatch Trails Foundation to express my support for the trail connection from the WOW trail to the Bonanza Loop Trail, and hope you will echo myself and others who support this critical trail connection. The Wasatch Trails Foundation has been working diligently with stakeholders including Park City Municipal, Mountain Trails Foundation, Utah Open Lands, Utah State Parks, Utah Division of Outdoor Recreation, Wasatch County and nearby landowners to develop and fund an alignment for this trail that fits within the Bonanza Flat Management Plan, disturbs as little of the natural environment as possible, and meets the needs of users while creating a critical trail and community connection. Through this work we believe we have landed on an ideal alignment that you as a council can confidently support, and be proud to bring this incredible amenity to the Wasatch Back while remaining a strong steward of the land and the flora and fauna that inhabit it. I strongly support, and encourage you to support the Bonanza to WOW trail and the trail and community connectivity it will create at your meeting on Thursday, October 5th 2023. Thank you for your consideration, your diligence, your commitment to being good stewards, and your service to the Park City and broader Wasatch back community.
source: eComment (written; published verbatim in council meeting minutes)

comment: I am not in favor of any new bonding now. Today the buying power of our dollar is reduced by 6% annually due to inflation. Prices for necessities such as food, clothing and shelter are increasing dramatically. At the same time interest rates are at a two decade high. This is not the time to encumber taxpayers by spending money on things that are not essential such as a new outdoor ice sheet and other upgrades to recreational facilities that would be nice but unnecessary.
